title: Paris Pulse content refresh — 2 October 2026
verification_note: Official source pages were opened on October 2. Search-backed retrieval can contain cached snapshots; Dundas was additionally checked in the live browser. Reopen time-sensitive sources immediately before publication. A source check verifies the published announcement, not on-the-ground conditions.
publishing_blocker: Primary editor workspace requires an editor/admin sign-in. No authorized editor session is present in the cloud browser. No database writes or production deployment performed.
publishing_notes: Match exact official URLs and existing slugs in production before inserts; preserve existing record IDs and URLs when correcting.
Use null coordinates unless verified from an authoritative source; none are invented in this batch.
Source-registry IDs from repository seeds are hints, not proof of current production rows. Select the actual authorized source in the editor.

Existing admin notice schema accepts title, summary, category, severity, source_id, official_url, coordinates, address, area, expires_at, is_sample, verification_status. It does not accept separate event start/end fields. Include event dates/timezone clearly in summaries; an authorized database operator can also preserve structured dates.
Editorial expiry is a freshness limit, not a promised reopening/completion date.
Date-only deadlines have no invented cutoff time. Keep them in notice text unless the deadline UI can represent date-only values accurately.
No notifications, emails, credential changes or secondary-site changes are included.

new_notices.title: Green Lane access closed from Dundas Street East
new_notices.summary: The County’s September 19 notice closes Green Lane access from Dundas Street East from September 22 to early November. Reach Green Lane via Consolidated Drive/Iarocci Boulevard. Governors Road East is westbound-only at Dundas; eastbound traffic detours via Paris Road. Business access remains available by the signed detours.
new_notices.affected_area_text: East Paris: Dundas Street East, Green Lane and Governors Road East
new_notices.freshness_note: Recheck within 72 hours; no exact completion day is announced.

new_notices.title: Penman’s Pass parking and stair access affected
new_notices.summary: Storm-sewer repairs beginning September 24 close half of the Penman’s Pass parking lot off Broadway Street West and the stairs to the trail and bridge. The paved trail remains available but is also used by construction equipment. Follow on-site directions. An end date for these specific restrictions has not been announced.
new_notices.freshness_note: Do not use the broader project’s 2028 completion as the parking/stair restriction end date.

new_notices.title: Mick Jones Way paving scheduled through October 2
new_notices.summary: Mick Jones Way between Willow and William streets is unavailable to vehicles during paving scheduled September 28–October 2, weather permitting. Temporary parking is available on both sides of Walnut Street. Check the original County notice for any extension; the scheduled end does not confirm the road has reopened.
new_notices.freshness_note: Publish today only, unless an extension is reverified.

new_notices.title: Snowplow names due October 9
new_notices.summary: County residents can submit one snowplow name for their home ward by October 9. An EngageBrant account is required and names must fit the 20-character limit. Voting on shortlisted names is scheduled for October 26–November 6. The source gives no submission cutoff time.

new_notices.title: Lions Park playground resurfacing planned this fall
new_notices.summary: The County plans new rubberized surfacing at Paris Lions Park’s playground this fall, after work at Burford Community Centre. The playground will close during construction, but Paris work dates have not yet been confirmed. Check the project page before making plans; this is an upcoming project, not confirmation that the playground is closed now.

new_notices.title: Check your voter letter by October 12
new_notices.summary: County of Brant voting runs online and by phone from October 19 at 9 a.m. to October 26 at 8 p.m. If your Voter Information Letter has not arrived by October 12, call the County at 519-442-7268. This is a letter-check date, not a registration cutoff. The County lists in-person voting assistance, including at Brant Sports Complex.
new_notices.freshness_note: After October 12, update headline to voting dates if reverified; do not present letter date as a voter-registration deadline.

new_notices.title: Meet the Maker: free crafts on October 3
new_notices.summary: Meet Kindred Spirits Artisans and try different arts and crafts on Saturday, October 3, 10 a.m.–2 p.m., at St. James Parish Hall, 8 Burwell Street, Paris. Admission is free. The organizer lists wheelchair access; no registration requirement is stated. Times are local to Paris.
new_notices.affected_area_text: St. James Parish Hall, 8 Burwell Street, Paris
new_notices.source_organization: Kindred Spirits Artisans of Paris via Culture Days

new_notices.title: Culture & Couture on October 3: register by October 2
new_notices.summary: Culture & Couture: Through the Eyes of Children runs Saturday, October 3, 3–5 p.m., in the upstairs Lafarge Hall at Brant Sports Complex, 944 Powerline Road. The free family activity explores fashion, fabrics and storytelling. Register on the organizer’s page by October 2; remaining availability and cutoff time are unconfirmed.
new_notices.affected_area_text: Brant Sports Complex, 944 Powerline Road, Paris
new_notices.source_organization: Vivienne Dacosta Design House Inc. via Culture Days
new_notices.freshness_note: Recheck registration immediately before publication and revise after October 2.

new_notices.title: Paris business-history walk on October 4: register by October 2
new_notices.summary: Explore historic downtown businesses on Sunday, October 4, 10 a.m.–noon, starting at Paris Museum & Historical Society in Syl Apps Community Centre, 51 William Street. Admission is free with optional donations. Register with the organizer by October 2; the tour is limited to 10 participants and remaining spaces are unconfirmed.
new_notices.affected_area_text: Paris Museum & Historical Society, 51 William Street, Paris
new_notices.source_organization: Paris Museum & Historical Society via Culture Days
new_notices.freshness_note: Recheck registration immediately before publication and revise after October 2.

new_notices.title: Brant Youth Centre returns October 13
new_notices.summary: Brant Youth Centre returns Tuesday, October 13 at Syl Apps Community Centre, 51 William Street, Paris. Weekly Tuesday sessions run 3:30–6:30 p.m. for ages 11–15. A $30 season membership covers October 2026–June 2027; use the County’s registration link for current membership details.
new_notices.affected_area_text: Syl Apps Community Centre, 51 William Street, Paris
new_notices.recurrence_note: Tuesdays; first-session notice only. Reverify calendar before generating additional occurrences.

new_notices.title: Paris Fall Market & Buttertart Festival: October 24–25
new_notices.summary: The Paris Fall Market & Buttertart Festival runs October 24 and 25, 11 a.m.–4 p.m. each day, at Paris Fairgrounds, 139 Silver Street. Shop artisans and food vendors. Cash gate admission: ages 10+ $6, ages 3–9 $2, ages 2 and under free. Parking is free; service dogs only.
new_notices.source_organization: Paris Agricultural Society venue listing / All Canadian Events
new_notices.freshness_note: Two daytime sessions, not continuous overnight. Recheck in the week before the event.

new_notices.title: Thanksgiving: no Brant Transit, regular curbside collection
new_notices.summary: Brant Transit will not operate on Monday, October 12. County garbage and blue-box collection remains on the regular schedule under the County’s holiday-collection policy, which excludes only Christmas and New Year’s Day. Put material out by 7 a.m. on your usual collection day.
new_notices.evidence_note: Transit explicitly names October 12. Waste statement applies the general published holiday policy; no separate Thanksgiving-specific waste announcement found.

new_notices.title: Urban yard-waste collection: October 19–23
new_notices.summary: Eligible urban residential properties have yard-waste collection October 19–23. Set paper yard-waste bags, open-top rigid containers or properly bundled branches out by 7 a.m. on your regular collection day. Plastic bags are not accepted. Collection may be later than your usual day but should finish by Saturday; check the eligibility map and set-out rules.
new_notices.affected_area_text: Eligible urban residential collection areas in Paris and County of Brant
new_notices.freshness_note: Do not imply every rural County address is eligible; date-specific set-out depends on the resident’s collection day.

new_notices.title: Household hazardous-waste drop-off on October 17
new_notices.summary: County of Brant residents can bring household hazardous waste to Mohawk Street Landfill, 20 Morrison Road, Brantford, on Saturday, October 17, 8 a.m.–4 p.m. Bring proof of residence. Household paint, cleaners and batteries are accepted; business, institutional and agricultural waste is excluded. Check the accepted-material list before travelling; dates may change.
new_notices.affected_area_text: Mohawk Street Landfill, 20 Morrison Road, Brantford; eligible for County of Brant residents
new_notices.source_organization: County of Brant / City of Brantford
new_notices.freshness_note: Off-site service useful to Paris residents. Do not label the venue as Paris. No fee claim is made.

new_notices.title: Brantwood Farms Fall Festival: October dates
new_notices.summary: Brantwood Farms’ Fall Festival runs October 3, 4, 10, 11, 12, 17, 18, 24, 25 and 31, 10 a.m.–5 p.m. (last entry 4 p.m.), at 351 German School Road. Activities include a corn maze and wagon rides. Admission is $17.50 plus HST per person; infants 23 months and younger are free. Check the farm’s booking page before visiting.
new_notices.affected_area_text: Brantwood Farms, 351 German School Road; rural County of Brant, Paris postal address
new_notices.priority: Optional additional event; requires an accurate organizer source entry
new_notices.freshness_note: Do not display as a daily month-long event. Recheck next upcoming weekend.
